d.t: In Hindustani classical music, the fast-paced conclusion of a raga, often characterized by the overwhelming of the melodic component by the rhythmic component.
The instant decapitation method of animal slaughter, idealized as a non-ritual alternative to ritual slaughter (kutha) which is forbidden
The meat of an animal slaughtered via the above method
A tribal form of cultivation in India, where a chosen piece of land is cleared and used to grow crops until its fertility is depleted.
